title.en: Comments on a static blog with giscus, and the three gotchas nobody mentions
title.zh: 用 giscus 给静态博客加评论，以及没人提的三个坑

excerpt.en: Wiring giscus (GitHub Discussions) into a static blog with no backend: derive the IDs from the API, fix the pathname-mapping trap on query-string routing, and patch all three CSP holes (script, frame AND style).
excerpt.zh: 给无后端的静态博客接 giscus（GitHub Discussions）：用 API 取 ID、修掉查询串路由下 pathname 映射的陷阱、补齐三个 CSP 洞（script、frame 和 style）。

title.en: Version history for a static blog, when the version store is already git
title.zh: 给静态博客做版本历史：版本库其实就是 git

excerpt.en: A post's versions are its git commits, so a Wikipedia/Zhihu-style edit history needs no backend: a registry-driven panel, view any past version from raw.githubusercontent.com, and an in-page diff with jsdiff + diff2html.
excerpt.zh: 一篇文章的版本就是它的 git commit，所以维基/知乎式的编辑记录无需后端：registry 驱动的面板、从 raw.githubusercontent.com 查看任意旧版、用 jsdiff + diff2html 做页内差异。

title.en: How I built this whole site: static, four-language, hand-illustrated
title.zh: 我是怎么搭起整个个人站点的：纯静态、四语言、手绘风

excerpt.en: A personal academic site as plain HTML/CSS/JS on GitHub Pages — runtime i18n from JSON, data-driven cards, a hand-built parchment design system, and git-push deploy. Copy-paste reproducible.
excerpt.zh: 把个人学术站做成 GitHub Pages 上的纯 HTML/CSS/JS：运行时从 JSON 做 i18n、数据驱动卡片、手工羊皮纸设计系统、git push 即部署。可复制复刻。

title.en: How I built this blog: a no-backend, client-rendered, four-language engine
title.zh: 我是怎么搭起这个博客的：无后端、客户端渲染、四语言引擎

excerpt.en: A blog with no second toolchain: Markdown posts fetched and rendered in the browser with marked, highlight.js, KaTeX, and mermaid; a JSON registry; TOC, reading progress, and a reading-size toggle. Reproducible by reading.
excerpt.zh: 不要第二套工具链的博客：Markdown 文章在浏览器里用 marked、highlight.js、KaTeX、mermaid 渲染；JSON registry；目录、阅读进度、字号切换。照着读就能复刻。

summary.en: Link the published GitHub repo; fix the resource & zip links
summary.zh: 接入已发布的代码仓库，修复资源 / zip 链接

title.zh: Ubuntu 上把搜狗换成 fcitx5：云拼音、模糊音，外加一只跑动的狗
title.en: Replacing Sogou with fcitx5 on Ubuntu: cloud pinyin, fuzzy pinyin, and a running dog
title.fr: Remplacer Sogou par fcitx5 sur Ubuntu : pinyin cloud, pinyin flou, et un chien qui court
title.de: Sogou durch fcitx5 unter Ubuntu ersetzen: Cloud-Pinyin, Fuzzy-Pinyin und ein laufender Hund

excerpt.zh: 搜狗在 Wayland 下打不出字，整套换成 fcitx5：云拼音、模糊音、自学习、Kimpanel 面板，外加云加载时一只跑动的狗。命令可直接复制。
excerpt.en: Sogou stopped typing under Wayland — a full move to fcitx5 with cloud pinyin, fuzzy pinyin, self-learning, a Kimpanel theme, and a dog that runs while the cloud loads. Copy-paste ready.
excerpt.fr: Sogou ne tapait plus sous Wayland — passage complet à fcitx5 : pinyin cloud, pinyin flou, auto-apprentissage, et un chien qui court pendant le chargement.
excerpt.de: Sogou tippte unter Wayland nicht mehr — kompletter Umstieg auf fcitx5: Cloud-Pinyin, Fuzzy-Pinyin, Selbstlernen und ein laufender Hund während des Ladens.
